correctness.rationale: For μ>0 connectedness makes the Metzler matrix irreducible, so its positive principal eigenvector is unique up to scale, including equal fitness. On complete graphs of order two and three the off-diagonal rank-one form gives p_i proportional to 1/(λ+nμ−f_i) with positive denominators, fixing the order. On the three-path the leaf denominators fix their relative order and a center–leaf tie requires λ=f_leaf. The simple eigenvalue derivative equals −pᵀLp/pᵀp, strictly negative unless p is constant, which is possible only with all fitnesses equal. Thus a single crossing, but not two, is allowed in general on the smaller shapes. For the four-path the first, third and fourth rows alone give sign(p3−p1)=sign(1−μ+μ²/(λ−3+μ)), where the last row gives λ−3+μ>0 and the ratio denominator from the third row is positive. This sign is positive at μ≤1. For μ>1 it is the sign of z*−λ, with z*=4+1/(μ−1)>4. The other eigenvalues are ≤3 by the min–max comparison to diag(f), so sign(z*−λ) equals the sign of the characteristic polynomial evaluated at z*. The independent tridiagonal recurrence factors that evaluation as μ²(μ²+2μ−2)F(μ)/(μ−1)^4, whose prefactor is positive for μ>1. Exact endpoint signs for F in the three disjoint brackets establish three simple roots, exactly two admissible. Their signs give the whole asserted ranking with no other tie. The same replay confirms the original remainder/resultant and high-μ correction; normalization does not change rankings.
residual_risks: No claim for unequal mutation rates, directed or disconnected graphs, multiplicative mutation–selection or graphs of order larger than four. A single crossing below order four is not excluded.

value.rationale: The sharp cutoff locates a genuine qualitative limit of a natural symmetric diffusion-plus-growth operator: monotonicity of the top eigenvalue does not make the ordering of its vector coordinates monotone. The minimal path, the exact interval, and the explicit exclusion of every smaller graph give a concise benchmark for reasoning about parameterized equilibrium rankings rather than a numerical example selected at isolated rates.
residual_risks: No empirical interpretation or claim about trajectories, other operators, or general larger-network crossing counts is needed for the value assessment.
